STA dm_jmin
    LDA viewport_left_high
    SBC movers_x_high,X
    BCS left_of_view                \ viewport_left >= x
    STZ dm_jmin                     \ 65C02 opcode
    BRA jmin_done                   \ 65C02 opcode
.left_of_view
    BEQ jmin_done                   \ high 0: the low byte is it
    LDA #&FF
    STA dm_jmin
.jmin_done
    LDA viewport_right_low
    SEC
    SBC movers_x_low,X
    STA dm_jmax
    LDA viewport_right_high
    SBC movers_x_high,X
    BCS not_right_of_view
    RTS                             \ the mover starts right of the viewport
.not_right_of_view
new:
LDA viewport_left_high          \ (the low byte only for its borrow: left_of_view redoes it)
    SBC movers_x_high,X
    BCS left_of_view                \ viewport_left >= x
    STZ dm_jmin                     \ 65C02 opcode
.jmin_done
    LDA viewport_right_low
    SEC
    SBC movers_x_low,X
    STA dm_jmax
    LDA viewport_right_high
    SBC movers_x_high,X
    BCS not_right_of_view
    RTS                             \ the mover starts right of the viewport
.left_of_view
    BEQ jmin_low                    \ high 0: the low byte is it
    LDA #&FF
    BRA jmin_store                  \ 65C02 opcode
.jmin_low
    LDA viewport_left_low           \ C set (BCS): the low byte again
    SBC movers_x_low,X
.jmin_store
    STA dm_jmin
    BRA jmin_done                   \ 65C02 opcode
.not_right_of_view
summary: jmin: hot path (mover starts right of viewport_left) is BCS-not-taken + STZ dm_jmin falling straight into jmin_done (6 cycles, was STA+BCS+STZ+BRA 13); the low difference is not stored early but redone on the rare left_of_view path, placed after the early RTS. Alternative to the next candidate (same lines).
equivalence: Single caller (render.6502:1189: JSR draw_mover, then LDX back / LDY dm_index / LDA v_ptr), so A, Y and flags are dead at every return. dm_jmin is read only at 1388/1464 (ren_draw_sprite, called after jmax_done), and every path still writes it before jmin_done; the early RTS path writes it too. Hot path (mover right of viewport_left, high-byte SBC borrows, C=0): dm_jmin=0 by STZ and falls into jmin_done with C=0 as before (the next SEC resets C anyway). Cold paths reach left_of_view by BCS with C=1 and Z from the high-byte SBC, exactly as before; high 0 stores the low difference, high nonzero stores &FF, then BRA jmin_done with A/flags dead (jmin_done begins LDA/SEC). The moved block sits after the unconditional RTS, so nothing falls into it; not_right_of_view keeps its place. Branch distances all under 40 bytes. jmax code unchanged. left_of_view high-0 path recomputes LDA viewport_left_low / SBC movers_x_low,X with C=1 from the BCS, the same value the old SEC/SBC stored. Measured: STZ 7.5 cycles = 1.875 hot executions, BCS taken ~0.12; cold path costs +10 cycles (20 vs 10), net 13.1-1.2 = 11.9 a pass.
relies_on: viewport_left_low (&B2) and movers_x_low,X not changed between the two reads (only game logic, prebuild and render setup write &B2; no interrupt writes either); Y/A/flags dead on return to the only caller.

skeptics.reason: Checked every path against src/render.6502:1241-1284 and the listing (&9A7A-&9A99). Entries: left_of_view and jmin_done are local to draw_mover's scope, referenced only by the branches in this block (grep); the moved block sits after the unconditional RTS so nothing falls into it; jmin_low/jmin_store are new names with no collisions; draw_mover's only caller is render.6502:1189. dm_jmin (&A341) final value on each old path: high SBC borrows (C=0) -> 0 (STZ, both); C=1,Z=1 -> low difference, recomputed as LDA &B2 / SBC movers_x_low,X with C=1 left by the taken BCS (BEQ does not touch C), X unchanged, so identical to the old SEC/SBC result; C=1,Z=0 -> &FF (both). dm_jmin is written before jmin_done on every path, so before the early RTS too; it is read only at 1388/1464 later. At jmin_done A,N,Z,C are overwritten by LDA viewport_right_low/SEC and V by the SBC at 1274, before any read; D is never changed; X and Y untouched; no stack change on any path (BRA only). Interrupt: irq1_handler (game.6502:4464 on) writes palette, VIAs, CRTC, acccon, romsel (restored), field_count, sfx state; nothing writes &B2 or movers_x_low, and the renderer itself writes neither between the two reads; &B2 and &1587+X lie outside the shadow window so acccon's X bit does not matter. Branch distances: BCS left_of_view ~20 bytes, BCS not_right_of_view ~17, BRA jmin_done back ~37, all in page &9A so no new page-crossing penalty. Recount from the window's measurements: removed STA dm_jmin runs 2/pass; hot path (1.875/pass) saves STA abs 4 + BRA 3 = 7; cold path (0.125/pass, taken BEQ) loses 4 and gains LDA zp 3 + SBC abs,X 4 + STA abs 4 + BRA 3 = +10; net 13.125 - 1.25 = 11.9 cycles a pass. Bytes: old unique 12, new 16: 4 bytes larger, i.e. -4 saved, as claimed. Not this lens but noted: everything after &9A99 in bank 4 (including dm_jmin and the renderer's other EQUB workspace) moves up 4 bytes, so the REN_BASE ASSERT and downstream page alignment are for the machine/project lenses and the gate.

Machine lens, not refuted. STZ abs and BRA are real 65SC12 opcodes (cmos = TRUE section). Recount against the listing (draw_mover at &9A47): hot path old STA dm_jmin abs 4 + BRA 3 (same page) = 7, new 0: saves 7. Cold high nonzero 15 -> 17 (+2); cold high 0 10 -> 20 (+10). New block lies wholly in page &9A (&9A72-&9A9C): no taken branch crosses a page, ranges small (BCS left_of_view +20, BRA jmin_done -33). jmin_low's recompute uses C=1 from the taken BCS, as SEC/SBC did; viewport_left_low (&B2) is not written inside draw_mover nor by any interrupt. Every path writes dm_jmin before jmin_done, including the early RTS. No self-modified or labelled operand in the changed bytes; the block after RTS is reached only by BCS. Bytes: old 22, new 26, grows by 4, so -4 is right under positive = smaller. CAVEAT on the a-pass figure (for passbench to decide): bank 4 from &9A99 on, and the data after render_end, moves up 4 bytes. Of 99 branches in &9A99-&A383, compact's BNE counted (&9FF7, byte-move loop, ~3.7 taken a pass) newly crosses a page: about +3.7 cycles a pass; compiled_part's BCS none stops crossing (about -0.1). ck_index,Y gains a crossing for Y=&2D-&30; bank-4 straight sprites' (zp),Y crossings change. Net nearer 8 cycles a pass than 11.9, still a gain.

Project lens: not refuted. render.6502 is hand-maintained (not GENERATED), the window has no PROTECTED line, and it is not raster-timed (render pass, bank 4). draw_mover has one caller (render.6502:1189). dm_jmin (&A341, bank 4 workspace) is read only at 1388 and 1464, and every new path writes it before jmin_done, so the RTS path still leaves it written. The second read of viewport_left_low (&B2, one name in zp.6502) and movers_x_low,X (&1587, main RAM below &3000, so ACCCON's X bit and ROMSEL do not change what it reads) happens in the same paging state as the first, a few cycles later. Nothing in between can change either: &B2 is written only by scroll_screen_right, skip_overflow_left_18e8, reset_screen_scroll, prebuild and render setup, and irq1_handler only calls sfx_tick. The cold high-0 path enters with C=1 from BCS (BEQ leaves C alone), the same carry as the old SEC, so it stores the same difference. No data, table, zero page or RAM moves. Size: dm_jmin is absolute, so the code is old 3*3+8=17 bytes against new 2*3+15=21 bytes, 4 larger (the claimed -4, where positive means smaller). The render region has 102 bytes free (SKIP PAD_END at &B39A against REN_BASE &B400, in both the ship and shift256end listings), so it fits. The block stays in page &9A (&9A7A-&9AB0), so no taken branch crosses a page, and every branch is well within range. Cycles: the hot path loses STA abs (4) and BRA (3), 7 an execution; 1.875 executions a pass (STZ measured at 7.5 cycles). The cold high-0 path costs 10 more (0.125 a pass), so about 11.9 a pass net. Only the in-play renderer runs draw_mover, so the front end, define controls, game over and the completion screen are not affected.
